capabilities: Create tomorrow's daily note from the Daily notes template and folder
Copy unchecked tasks from the most recent earlier daily note into it
Add a defer counter like (↻4) to each carried task
Roll unfinished tasks into today's note without opening it
Restrict rollover to tasks under a chosen heading
disambiguation: Not a general planner or calendar; it only creates tomorrow's daily note and copies unchecked tasks forward.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer on desktop and mobile; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: If you're using the daily-note core plugin to write your daily to-do list
motivation: The author wanted to plan the next day the night before while using the daily-note core plugin for a to-do list.
problem: Obsidian's Daily notes core plugin only creates today's note, so planning tomorrow and carrying unfinished tasks forward means copying them by hand.
summary: Daily-notes companion that creates tomorrow's daily note and copies unchecked tasks from the most recent earlier note, with defer counters.
